translation.english_title: O realm of love, O new dream

english_lines: O realm of love, O new dream — O blissful flame
That dwells in the heart, come running.
notes: `காதல் துறை` is kept as the image-bearing `realm of love`; the line is not reduced to `my love`.
`ஓடிவா` remains `come running`, preserving the urgency of the source rather than smoothing it to `come to me`.

english_lines: When I see the great cloud roaming the sky,
notes: `கலாபம்` is retained through the image of plumage rather than paraphrased as `the garden rejoices`; the source's visual motion remains central.

english_lines: O great gem born of love...
You are the treasure of a blissful life.
O maiden who stands dancing in my eyes.
notes: The eye/dancing image is preserved directly rather than normalized to `the girl I always see`.

english_lines: Let us behold the boundary of bliss...
notes: `எல்லை` remains `boundary`, retaining the source's spatial metaphor for joy.
`வீணை` is retained as `veena`, preserving the culture-bearing instrument image.

english_lines: This is a life without equal.
O moon of love, O new dream — O blissful flame
That dwells in the heart — come running.
notes: The closing variation changes `காதல் துறை` to `காதல் நிலவு`; the English preserves that source variation instead of forcing a uniform refrain.

translator_notes: The source turn labels `முத்தாயி`, `முத்தன்`, and `இருவரும்` remain exact; no performer identities are inferred.
The translation preserves the source's cloud, plumage, gem, dancing-maiden, boundary, veena, moon and flame images rather than replacing them with generic romantic language.
This is a literary source-faithful translation, not a singable adaptation.
